reports.title: Rosstat acknowledges cyberattacks as groups publish estimates of Russian war deaths
reports.note: Russia’s federal statistics agency acknowledged attacks between October 29 and November 1 and denied a data leak. Silent Crow and Cyber Partisans say they used death records to estimate war deaths. The totals are the groups’ estimates. The extent of any data destruction remains unverified.

reports.title: Vanderbilt University responds to a cybersecurity incident
reports.note: The university asked staff and students to disconnect university devices. A group claimed it had encrypted databases and stolen records. The university’s initial statement confirmed the incident without confirming those claims.

reports.title: French blood service reports disruption to refrigeration at three sites
reports.note: France’s blood service said a supplier incident affected refrigeration controls at three facilities. The service identified its supplier as the target.
